song_craft: Study-and-making song (7v): studied speech → god-made → foe-included → system-end → merged ground → stages gained → sixfold road. Voice: hermetic couplets, hyphen-pressure; music in pack + terminal words.

lines: Rest-filled with power gone within, beginning to end — unspeakable —
I study speech: the Lord's heart.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ādyantāntargatānantaśaktiviśrāntinirbharām anuccāryām | ahaṃ vācam adhīye hṛdayaṃ vibhoḥ

verses.craft: Study-vow: anuccāryām kept (unspeakable-not-unspoken per UNC); rest-filled end-weight.
verses.rejected: (a) unspoken → killed by UNC. (b) unpacking beginning-end-entered → killed: pack is the study.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['anuccāryām kept (unspeakable, not unspoken).']) / C1 essence / rasa relish-pattern / L2+L3 voice

lines: He, Bhairava god indeed — all gods, of-Him-made;
she, Bhairavī — being, non-being too, of-Him-made.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sa eva bhairavo devas sarve devāś ca yanmayāḥ | saivāsau bhairavī sattāsattāpi ca yanmayī

verses.craft: God-made gods; goddess being-nonbeing-made — of-Him-made anaphora ×2 (row 9).
verses.rejected: (a) trimming second made → killed: doubling is the making. (b) Bhairavī→goddess gloss → killed: name load-bearing.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa relish-pattern / L2+L3 voice

lines: His knowing, His unknowing too — that, of-Him-made;
He, Bhairava's own school — its foe too, of-Him-made.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tad eva bhairavaṃ jñānam ajñānam api yanmayam | sa hi bhairavasiddhāntaḥ pūrvapakṣo 'pi yanmayaḥ

verses.craft: Foe included (adbhuta of foe-included): school AND foe both made — inclusion without exception.
verses.rejected: (a) softening foe → killed: inclusion is the shock. (b) explaining made → killed.

lines: One-ness of six roads — where Bhairavī stands —
past all systems' end — unsayable, supreme, the goal.
l4.sanskrit_cite: aikadhyam adhvanāṃ ṣa.ṅnāṃ yatra sā bhairavī sthitiḥ | paryante sarvatantrāṇām avācyā paramā gatiḥ

lines: From knowing's own nature, that god mirroring by himself —
Lord, from unheld to stages' end — stages he gains.
l4.sanskrit_cite: citsvābhāvyād asau devaḥ svātmanā vimṛṣan prabhuḥ | anāśritādibhūmyantā bhūmikāḥ pratipadyate

lines: There — speaker, spoken, self — of two throbs singly —
Lord's gross, fine, supreme shine — sequences' sixfold road.
